newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady on pre-holiday demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady on pre-holiday demand.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Monday were steady amid healthy demand, traders said.
"There is still demand from those stragglers who refused to pay up and now have to," said one major. Majors offered 380 cst at $126-$128 per tonne delivered and 180 cst at $133-$134.50.
Independents selling ex-wharf however said indications have eased with crude, offering 380-cst at $125 and 380-cst at $129. Supplies after December 26 were healthy, they said.
MDO and gas oil were steady at $238-$245, $255-$263 respectively.
